about.title: From the code to the servers that run it.
paragraphs: I started my career as a {{ink:Full Stack Developer}} in 2015, building enterprise applications for government and private sector clients with PHP, Vue.js, and MySQL. Over time my scope widened into infrastructure — and now I work across both: the product, and the platform that runs it.

Today I'm a {{ink:DevOps Engineer}} at Linguise, a French website-translation platform, where I optimize MySQL databases holding billions of rows, design failover strategies, and automate the entire deployment process with Ansible and CI/CD.
Before that, at Shieldtag, I led the engineering team building a product authentication & traceability platform — from the Node.js/Express backend to the Next.js frontend.

e-office.title: E-Office — Enterprise Document & Workflow Management System
e-office.description: A digital correspondence and workflow management platform that replaces paper-based approval chains with a centralized, trackable system — built for government and enterprise organizations with multi-level sign-off requirements.
e-office.challenge: Correspondence and approvals moved between departments on paper or over email, with no central record of where a document was in the process. That meant delays, lost documents, and no audit trail when something needed to be traced back.
e-office.approach: I built a centralized workflow engine that routes each document through a configurable approval chain matching the institution's own org structure, with role-based access so every user only sees what's relevant to them, and a full status log at every step.
e-office.outcome: Deployed across 7 institutions — including INALUM, BKKBN Yogyakarta, and several regency governments — turning correspondence that used to take days into a same-day approval flow, with a complete digital audit trail.

e-monev.title: E-Monev — Government Monitoring & Evaluation Platform
e-monev.description: A web-based monitoring and evaluation system that gives government agencies a real-time view of budget realization, project progress, and performance indicators — replacing manual spreadsheet consolidation.
e-monev.challenge: Regional governments tracked budget realization and project KPIs through spreadsheets submitted manually by each department. Consolidating them into a single up-to-date picture for leadership was slow and error-prone.
e-monev.approach: I built a centralized reporting platform where departments submit progress data directly through the system, with dashboards that roll budget realization, project milestones, and KPI tracking up to leadership in real time.
e-monev.outcome: Adopted by 5 regional governments to track budget realization and project progress in real time, cutting out the manual back-and-forth of spreadsheet consolidation.

covid-gis-tracking.title: COVID-19 Screening & GIS Tracking System
covid-gis-tracking.description: A public health platform built during the pandemic to support citizen self-screening, contact tracing, case monitoring, and geographic visualization of health data for local officials.
covid-gis-tracking.challenge: In the early stages of the pandemic, Sleman Regency needed a fast way to screen citizens, trace contacts, and see where cases were emerging geographically — with no existing system in place to do any of it.
covid-gis-tracking.approach: I built a citizen self-screening portal that feeds a case-monitoring dashboard, plus a GIS layer plotting screening results and confirmed cases geographically so health officials could spot emerging clusters early.
covid-gis-tracking.outcome: Deployed for Sleman Regency Government in 2020, giving health officials a real-time geographic view of screening and case data during a critical early phase of the pandemic response.
